evidence.quote: In order to enroll in BAI, a B2 proficiency level in English is required.
Application period for non-EU students residing outside Italy for the academic year 2026-2027 will take place between April 28 and May 18.
Start date: April 28, 2026, 12.00 AM (Italian time) Closing date: May 18. 2026, 11.59 PM (Italian time)

notes: Tuition: no figure extracted. The pages give only an income-based all-inclusive fee (ISEE/equivalent ISEE) or a nationality-based Flat Rate for non-EU students, but no accepted quote ties this programme or its degree group to a specific 2026/27 amount, and no accepted quote names Morocco in a country-group list for the amount; per the task rules a tuition figure cannot be given. Application channel: the programme page does not name Universitaly, but the linked Pavia pages show that non-EU applicants residing abroad must use the Universitaly portal for pre-enrolment (preiscrizione) for a study visa, so it-universitaly. More rounds exist (a new application window is published each year); the extracted window is the one stated for a.y. 2026/2027. Documents listed are those in the application-form section for non-EU applicants residing outside Italy; the linked pre-enrolment/visa page additionally requires Passport, Photocard, Secondary School diploma (issued in English/Spanish/French or officially translated into Italian) and Admission letter/Conditional offer letter.

evidence.quote: Students must have a knowledge of the English language corresponding to at least B2 level of the Common European Framework (CEF).
However, an English certification is not mandatory, since the knowledge of the language is verified through the entrance test carried out in English.
High-school diploma awarded after at least 12 years of documented education

note.fr: Test d'admission obligatoire (SAT) : score minimum 979/1600 ; classement par score. Vérifier les détails dans l'appel à candidatures annuel.
note.en: Compulsory admission test (SAT): minimum score 979/1600; ranking by score. Check details in the annual call for applications.

evidence.quote: The minimum score to compete for a spot is ≥ 979/1600.
